ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B2-3,
Neighborhood Mixed-Use Districts and B3-2, Community Shopping Districts symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 18-C and Map No. 18-B in the area bound by:

South Crandon Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to East 75" Street;
South Yates Avenue; a line 128.2 feet north of and parallel to East 75" Street;
South Phillips Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to East 75" Street,
South Colfax Avenue; a line 122.38 feet north of East 75" Street as measured
along South Colfax Avenue; South Exchange Avenue; the alley next north of and
parallel to East 75" Street; a line 212.4 feet east of and parallel to South
Exchange Avenue; East 75" Street; South Exchange Avenue; a line 97 feet north
of and parallel to East 76" Street; a line 167 feet east of and parallel to South
Saginaw Avenue; a line 197 feet north of and parallel to East 76" Street; South
Saginaw Avenue; a line 197 feet south of and parallel to East 75" Street; South
Colfax Avenue; and the alley next south of and parallel to East 75" Street,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District,

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Alderman, \7th Ward
